CVE-2026-53615 affects libblkid DOS partition 64-bit bounds checking in util-linux before 2.41.4. The Debian security update util-linux 2.41.5-0+deb13u1 was released specifically to address the CVE-2026-5361x family for trixie and incorporates the upstream fix from v2.41.4 (commit 05c2dbadf34cc74192287f377904afaaf4061623). This version does not contain the vulnerable code path.
Package util-linux in Debian does build with readline support but chfn and chsh are provided by src:shadow and util-linux is configured with --disable-chfn-chsh.

Alias of CVE-2026-57585. pip vendors msgpack 1.1.2 without the vulnerable _cmsgpack C extension; only the pure-Python fallback is present under pip/_vendor/msgpack.

pip's vendored msgpack is the pure-Python fallback only (fallback.py, ext.py, exceptions.py). CVE-2026-57585 is a use-after-free in the Cython _cmsgpack extension; pip does not ship that native module and always falls back to the pure-Python implementation.

Same pip vendor BOM artifact as CVE-2025-47273. The MANIFEST.in Unicode-normalization sdist exclusion bug is in setuptools' sdist build path; pip does not ship that code—only a pkg_resources subset for importlib metadata.

Scanners report setuptools@70.3.0 when pip 26.2's CycloneDX vendor BOM is ingested. DHI python3-pip ships the upstream pip wheel unchanged: pip vendors only a stripped pkg_resources tree derived from setuptools 70.3.0 and does not ship setuptools/package_index.py where this path-traversal flaw lives.

CVE-2024-26461 is a memory leak in an error path of lib/gssapi/krb5/k5sealv3.c that cannot be triggered through the public GSSAPI calls; Debian marks it unimportant with negligible security impact and plans no fix. In this image libgssapi-krb5-2 1.21.3-5+deb13u1 is present only as a transitive dependency of libcurl's GSS-API/SPNEGO support for client tools (curl, git-remote-https); no Kerberos-consuming daemon ships, the entrypoint is a bash passthrough (exec "$@") with default cmd /bin/bash, and the defect is an availability-only leak in a path an adversary cannot drive.

CVE-2024-26458 is a memory leak in lib/rpc/pmap_rmt.c, which is compiled into the gssrpc library; Debian ships that as libgssrpc.so.4 in the libgssrpc4t64 package, which is not installed in this image. Verified in the built image: dpkg lists no gssrpc package and no Debian-built libgssrpc exists under /usr/lib (dpkg installs only libkrb5-3, libgssapi-krb5-2, libkrb5support0, libk5crypto3). The libgssrpc.so.4 under /opt/conda/pkgs belongs to conda-forge's own krb5 1.22.1 build, a separate newer component not built from this Debian source package.

CVE-2018-5709 is an integer overflow in kadmin/dbutil/dump.c, the KDC database dump utility that operates on trusted administrator input; Debian marks it unimportant as a non-issue. That code ships only in the KDC administration packages (kdb5_util in krb5-kdc, kadmind in krb5-admin-server), none of which are installed here. Verified in the built image: dpkg lists only the runtime libraries libkrb5-3, libgssapi-krb5-2, libkrb5support0, and libk5crypto3 from the krb5 source package, and a filesystem search finds no kdb5_util, kadmin, or kprop binaries.

Integer underflow and heap out-of-bounds read in berval2tl_data() in the LDAP KDB backend plugin (plugins/kdb/ldap/libkdb_ldap/ldap_principal2.c). Triggering requires a KDC or kadmind configured with an LDAP database backend whose backend returns a krbExtraData attribute with bv_len < 2; that data originates from the trusted KDB datastore, not from an external Kerberos protocol client, so it cannot be controlled by an adversary. Debian marks this unimportant (bug 1139821) with no security impact and notes it does not cross any security boundary.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
